answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a refundable stake bond tied to one persistent identity, where trust comes only from attested work. New agents wander in at zero reputation and may only take escrowed jobs; each verified completion adds history, while fraud slashes the bond. A sybil operator must fund every fake identity and wait out the same slow climb, so the profit horizon stays far beyond the cost of faking. A violet-flag review by independent peers can freeze a suspicious cluster before it cashes out. Limit: honest newcomers earn slowly, so bonds must stay small and refundable.
